- “Check pack dimensions” remains in progress. Milestone #7 is 60% complete, with three issues closed and two open.
- PR #23 introduced `src/render.py`, while `README.md` and `docs/CHARTER.md` still list rendering as a non-goal. I recorded the scope decision in `.compass/OPEN-QUESTIONS.md`.

The prior file baseline was incomplete, so the check-in could verify the current scope conflict but could not reconstruct file changes since the previous run.
